The Role:
We are seeking an ML Training Infrastructure Engineer to elevate the engineering practices across our Machine Learning and EdgeAI teams and improve their velocity. In this role, you will act as a shared champion of DevOps / MLOps excellence. Your mission is to drive excellent model training by designing the reusable scaffolding (templates, CI/CD pipelines, and data management workflows) that allows our ML engineers to work faster, smarter, and with absolute consistency. A key focus of this role is optimizing training pipelines to fully leverage our High Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure, ensuring scalability and performance. You are the interface with our Digital Office (who manage core AWS/HPC resources and MLOps infrastructure) and the applied ML teams, ensuring knowledge transfer and engineering best practices are seamlessly integrated.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will look after:

• Infrastructure rollout & onboarding: Lead infrastructure migration and adoption by guiding ML engineers to new shared compute environments, optimizing developer workflows to reduce friction, and providing comprehensive documentation and hands-on training to ensure team upskilling.

• Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Act as the internal consultant and coach for ML teams for High Performance Computing (HPC) optimization. Run workshops, pair-program on pipeline bottlenecks, and document modern MLOps standards to upskill the engineering org and facilitate knowledge sharing.

• Standardization & Templating: Design and maintain "cookie-cutter" project templates. Ensure any ML engineer can spin up a new repository that is automatically compliant, structured, and integrated with data/artifact versioning.

• CI/CD & Continuous Training (CT): Build and maintain robust automation pipelines. Design the triggers and workflows that automate data validation, model retraining, and evaluation when new data arrives or performance baselines change.

• Compute & Code Optimization: Partner with ML engineers to profile and optimize training pipelines and local/edge inference code in pair work, ensuring high efficiency on local host computers and specialized compute resources.

• Digital Office Liaison: Act as the primary technical point of contact to translate the Digital Office’s AWS policies, high-efficiency compute setups, and infrastructure realities into practical, developer-friendly workflows for the ML teams. You are the product owner of the MLOps toolchain making sure the requirements of the ML team are implemented as tools by the Digital Office.

• AI Governance & Data Stewardship: Establish and enforce frameworks for ethical AI, model transparency (via model cards), and data privacy compliance. Act as the steward of our data ecosystem by aligning processes for data inventory, lifecycle management, and accessibility, ensuring that high-quality, compliant data is readily available for training and inference across all projects.

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• Education: PhD or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, or Software Engineering with a heavy focus on developer tooling, automation, platform enablement and pipeline optimization. Il ruolo e il team: Logitech sta cercando un Lead Motor e Drive Engineer per guidare la progettazione, lo sviluppo e l'integrazione di sistemi di attuazione motorizzata per prodotti innovativi di consumo e professionali. Questo ruolo è ideale per un ingegnere esperto con profonda esperienza in motori, elettronica di trasmissione, controllo del movimento e integrazione del sistema meccatronico. Come Lead Motor e Drive Engineer, si possiede lo sviluppo tecnico dei sottosistemi motore e di azionamento dal concetto iniziale attraverso il lancio di produzione. Potrai lavorare attraverso software, sistemi, affidabilità, sourcing e team di produzione meccanici, elettrici, incorporati per fornire soluzioni di movimento ad alte prestazioni, affidabili, silenziose, efficienti e manufacturable in scala. Questi sono i comportamenti e i valori di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Guidare l'architettura, il design e lo sviluppo di sistemi di motore e di azionamento per i prodotti Logitech.
• Definire i requisiti del sottosistema per coppia, velocità, efficienza, acustica, comportamento termico, durata e controllabilità.
• Selezionare e sviluppare motori, ingranaggi, encoder, sensori, driver e elettronica di alimentazione per soddisfare le esigenze del prodotto.
• Progettare e ottimizzare le soluzioni di controllo del movimento per prestazioni, affidabilità, rumore, vibrazioni, consumo energetico e costi.
• Partner con software integrato e team di ingegneria elettrica su algoritmi di controllo motore, sistemi di feedback e implementazione del drive.
• Modellazione del sistema di supporto, simulazione, prototipazione, caratterizzazione e convalida della progettazione.
• Analisi dei tradeoff di piombo attraverso le prestazioni degli attuatori, i vincoli di imballaggio, l'esperienza dell'utente, l'affidabilità e la manufacturability.
• Guida l'analisi causa radice e risoluzione dei problemi per problemi relativi alla qualità del movimento, il comportamento termico, EMC, la durata e le prestazioni del campo.
• Sviluppare piani di validazione, metodi di prova e criteri di accettazione per i sottosistemi motore e di azionamento.
• Collabora con i fornitori per definire le specifiche, rivedere i progetti, qualificare i componenti e migliorare le prestazioni del sottosistema.
• Assicurarsi che i progetti soddisfino requisiti normativi, di sicurezza e di qualità, se applicabile.
• Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica tra cui requisiti, recensioni di progettazione, FMEA, report di prova e specifiche di produzione.

• Laurea o master in elettronica di potenza, ingegneria elettrica, meccatronica, robotica, o un campo relativo.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di motori, attuatori o sistemi di azionamento.
• Forte conoscenza di motori DC, motori BLDC, motori stepper, sistemi servo e relative architetture di azionamento.
• Esperienza con principi di controllo motore, tra cui controllo a circuito chiuso, sistemi di feedback e regolazione delle prestazioni
• Forte comprensione dell'elettronica di potenza, dei conducenti di motore, del rilevamento e dell'integrazione degli attuatori.
• Esperienza con il design del sistema meccatronico, comprese le interazioni tra elementi meccanici, elettrici e software.
• Familiarità con strumenti di simulazione e analisi per sistemi di movimento, comportamento termico e prestazioni dinamiche
• Esperienza definendo ed eseguendo i piani di validazione per le prestazioni del motore e dell'azionamento, l'affidabilità e la prontezza di produzione.
• Forte risoluzione dei problemi e competenze di analisi causa-radice nei sistemi hardware complessi.

The role and team:
Logitech is seeking a Lead Motor and Drive Engineer to lead the design, development, and integration of motorized actuation systems for innovative consumer and professional products. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer with deep expertise in motors, drive electronics, motion control, and mechatronic system integration.

As a Lead Motor and Drive Engineer, you will own the technical development of motor and drive subsystems from early concept through production launch. You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, systems, reliability, sourcing, and manufacturing teams to deliver motion solutions that are high performing, reliable, quiet, efficient, and manufacturable at scale.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Lead the architecture, design, and development of motor and drive systems for Logitech products.

• Define subsystem requirements for torque, speed, efficiency, acoustics, thermal behavior, lifetime, and controllability.

• Select and develop motors, geartrains, encoders, sensors, drivers, and power electronics to meet product needs.

• Design and optimize motion control solutions for performance, reliability, noise, vibration, power consumption, and cost.

• Partner with embedded software and electrical engineering teams on motor control algorithms, feedback systems, and drive implementation.

• Support system modeling, simulation, prototyping, characterization, and design validation.

• Lead tradeoff analysis across actuator performance, packaging constraints, user experience, reliability, and manufacturability.

• Drive root-cause analysis and problem resolution for issues related to motion quality, thermal behavior, EMC, durability, and field performance.

• Develop validation plans, test methods, and acceptance criteria for motor and drive subsystems.

• Collaborate with suppliers to define specifications, review designs, qualify components, and improve subsystem performance.

• Ensure designs meet regulatory, safety, and quality requirements where applicable.

• Create and maintain technical documentation including requirements, design reviews, FMEAs, test reports, and production specifications.

• Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across mechatronic subsystem development.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in motor, actuator, or drive system development.

• Strong knowledge of DC motors, BLDC motors, stepper motors, servo systems, and related drive architectures.

• Experience with motor control principles including closed-loop control, feedback systems, and performance tuning

• Strong understanding of power electronics, motor drivers, sensing, and actuator integration.

• Experience with mechatronic system design, including interactions between mechanical, electrical, and software elements.

As a trusted partner to the CCO and Leadership Team, you will play a key role in enabling leadership effectiveness, driving operational excellence, and supporting the execution of strategic priorities across a global organization.
Working closely with senior stakeholders across regions and functions, you will manage executive priorities, coordinate key initiatives, facilitate leadership processes, and foster collaboration across teams. The successful candidate will bring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Your Contribution:

• Manage complex calendars and schedule meetings, travel arrangements, and other executive commitments, ensuring optimal time allocation and prioritization of meetings, appointments, and events.

• Arrange domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation, while adhering to budget and company travel policies.

• Prepare and manage correspondence, emails, reports, presentations, and other documents as needed.

• Draft and proofread emails, memos, presentations, and other correspondence on behalf of the Chief Commercial Officer and leadership team, ensuring clear and concise communication.

• Coordinate logistics for meetings, prepare agendas and materials, take minutes, and track action items.

• Lead and coordinate global events and executive engagements from planning through execution, partnering with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.

• Assist with special projects, research, data collection, and analysis as required.

Location: Lausanne Working Model: 2-3 days/week in the office The Role and the Team: At Logitech, we don’t just build tools. We bridge the gap between people and the digital world. As the world shifts toward a video-first culture, the "Personal Work Solutions" team is at the epicenter of how humans create together, and project their identity and creativity to the world. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who views video not as a utility, but as an experience. You will lead the next generation of video solutions, blending cutting-edge hardware with AI-driven software to create world-class solutions serving millions of users in both B2C and B2B. This is an exciting role in a fast paced environment, where the right person can make a huge impact. You’ll be based in Lausanne, Switzerland, part of the Personal Work Solutions (PWS) business group. Your role will be global, with occasional travel across regions. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
• Lead the creation, development, and launch of seamless video experiences and innovative webcam solutions leveraging advanced technologies (AI, computer vision, etc.)
• Enable millions of people worldwide to connect, collaborate, and express themselves with confidence
• Maintain Logitech’s #1 global webcam market position, driving breakthrough product launches for measurable business growth and best in class customer satisfaction
• Guide multidisciplinary teams, working closely with Business, Industrial Design, UX, SW & HW Engineering teams to transform ideas and users insights into iconic, industry-defining products, all the way to mass production
• Ensure end-to-end user journey at every touchpoint. Ensuring our solutions work beautifully for diverse global audiences in B2B & B2C, across 50+ countries
• Deeply understand consumer and enterprise needs to generate actionable insights throughout development
• Shape the future of video interaction through advanced technology integration, competitive intelligence, and proactive identification of innovation and white-space opportunities
• Partner with business teams to explore and execute new revenue opportunities through innovative product offerings Key Qualifications For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
• 7+ years of demonstrable experience in a product management position, with successful development and launches of software and hardware solutions
• Experience with video technologies and trends, ideally in video hardware
• Proven track record applying the Design Thinking approaches to drive innovation processes and managing complex initiatives from concept to launch, ideally in a hardware/software integrated environment.
• Curiosity and passion for users. Fluent in conducting user tests and qualitative consumer research
• Strong business acumen with passion for consumer electronics
• Curiosity, hands-on engagement, autonomy, and an entrepreneurial mindset
• Strong analytical skills and technical understanding, with ability to communicate effectively with engineers
• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of motivating teams and working effectively across departments.
• Strong written and oral communication skills in English.
• High energy, a positive attitude, and integrity Education

You will be capable of influencing and contributing to the product strategy and roadmap, enhancing its feature set, and working with cross-functional teams to create the products in said roadmap. • Develop detailed product requirements for products.
• Collaborate with designers, engineers, and software teams to deliver solutions that meet business and customer needs.

• Agreed product strategy with Head of Sim.
• Communication of product benefits and messaging with Marketing.
• Business Case Financials, including forecasting with Go-to-market.
